result.instructions: Tools for ExpenseOnDemand, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which expense claims were approved this month, grouped by cost centre?"; "Export last week's new accounting items for report 12."; "Add a new employee, Sam Lee, as a Claimant with approver manager@acme.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ExpenseOnDemand data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run expenseondemand_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run expenseondemand_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run expenseondemand_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. expenseondemand_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: expenseondemand_export_accounting
tools.title: Export accounting data
tools.description: Fetch approved expense data for an accounting integration, filtered by report, date range, category, claimant, cost centre, grade and payment type. Reads data only; the POST carries the filter body. Accounting API: POST /accounting/api/AccountingExport.

exportReportId.description: Export report id (one the organisation has; see expenseondemand_list_export_templates).

fromDate.description: Start of the expense submission date range.

toDate.description: End of the expense submission date range.

expenseCategoryFilter.description: Expense category ids (list of ids; leave out for no filter).

claimantFilter.description: Claimant ids (list of ids; leave out for no filter).

costCenterFilter.description: Cost centre ids (list of ids; leave out for no filter).

claimantTypeFilter.description: Claimant type ids (list of ids; leave out for no filter).

gradeFilter.description: Grade ids (list of ids; leave out for no filter).

paymentTypeFilter.description: Payment type ids (list of ids; leave out for no filter).

tools.name: expenseondemand_get_payroll_export
tools.title: Get payroll export
tools.description: Get the total approved expense amount per employee for payroll: name, email, expense count and total amount. Accounting API: GET /accounting/api/PayrollExport.

tools.name: expenseondemand_list_export_templates
tools.title: List export templates
tools.description: List the export report types configured for the subscription, with their report ids and fields. Use a reportId as exportReportId in expenseondemand_export_accounting. Meta API: GET /meta/api/GetExportTemplates.

tools.name: expenseondemand_list_expense_categories
tools.title: List expense categories
tools.description: List the expense categories of the subscription with id, name, active flag and base category id. Meta API: GET /meta/api/GetExpenseCategoriesForOrganisation.

tools.name: expenseondemand_list_grades
tools.title: List grades
tools.description: List the employee grades of the subscription with id, name and active flag. Meta API: GET /meta/api/GetGradesForOrganisation.

tools.name: expenseondemand_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers of the subscription with id, name, codes and active flag. Customer API: GET /customer/api/GetCustomersForOrganisation.

tools.name: expenseondemand_add_customer
tools.title: Add a customer
tools.description: Add a customer to the subscription. The id is generated by ExpenseOnDemand. Creates a new record each call. Customer API: POST /customer/api/AddCustomerForSubscription.

tools.name: expenseondemand_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update an existing customer by id. Send every field you want to keep: the vendor may clear fields you leave out, so read the record first with expenseondemand_list_customers. Customer API: POST /customer/api/UpdateCustomerForSubscription.

id.description: Id of the customer to update (from expenseondemand_list_customers).

tools.name: expenseondemand_list_cost_centres
tools.title: List cost centres
tools.description: List the cost centres of the subscription with id, name, codes and active flag. Cost Centre API: GET /costCentre/api/GetCostCentresForOrganisation.

tools.name: expenseondemand_add_cost_centre
tools.title: Add a cost centre
tools.description: Add a cost centre to the subscription. The id is generated by ExpenseOnDemand. Creates a new record each call. Cost Centre API: POST /costCentre/api/AddCostCentreForSubscription.

isActive.description: Whether the cost centre is active.

tools.name: expenseondemand_update_cost_centre
tools.title: Update a cost centre
tools.description: Update an existing cost centre by id. Send every field you want to keep: the vendor may clear fields you leave out, so read the record first with expenseondemand_list_cost_centres. Cost Centre API: POST /costCentre/api/UpdateCostCentreForSubscription.

id.description: Id of the cost centre to update (from expenseondemand_list_cost_centres).

isActive.description: Whether the cost centre is active.

tools.name: expenseondemand_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (employees) of the subscription with email, name, status (1 Active, 2 Inactive, 3 NotInvited, 4 Pending, 5 Deleted), role and approver email. Users API: GET /users/api/GetUsersForOrganisation.

tools.name: expenseondemand_add_employee
tools.title: Invite an employee
tools.description: Add an employee to the subscription. ExpenseOnDemand treats the new employee as invited. Creates a record each call, so check expenseondemand_list_users first. Users API: POST /users/api/AddEmployee.

employeeId.description: Employee ID 1 (your HR or payroll id).

approverEmail.description: Email of the approver assigned to this employee.

tools.name: expenseondemand_update_employee
tools.title: Update an employee
tools.description: Update an existing employee, identified by email. Send every field you want to keep: the vendor may clear fields you leave out, so read the record first with expenseondemand_list_users. Users API: POST /users/api/UpdateEmployee.

employeeId.description: Employee ID 1 (your HR or payroll id).

approverEmail.description: Email of the approver assigned to this employee.

tools.name: expenseondemand_deactivate_employee
tools.title: Deactivate an employee
tools.description: Deactivate an employee by email, so they can no longer submit or approve expenses. Users API: POST /users/api/DeactivateEmployee.

email.description: Email ID of the employee to deactivate.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ExpenseOnDemand
prompts.description: What you can do with ExpenseOnDemand here, with example requests to try.
